question: Which export goods experienced the largest declines in value between 2008 and 2010 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg?

limitations.message: Values are in current euros (nominal), not adjusted for price changes.
1.8 % of this value is confidential at full product detail (masked codes); it is shown as a separate 'Confidential' slice, never dropped.

sql:
SELECT
  year,
  hs2 AS key,
  flow,
  SUM(value_eur) AS value_eur,
  SUM(qty_kg) AS qty_kg
FROM v_lu_trade_hs2
WHERE
  period >= CAST('2008-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND period < CAST('2011-01-01' AS DATE)
  AND flow = 'export'
  AND year IN (2008, 2010)
GROUP BY
  year,
  key,
  flow
ORDER BY
  year,
  value_eur DESC
LIMIT 10000
title: Largest changes by product group — exports 2008–2010

main.label: Preparations of vegetables, fruit, nuts or other parts of plants

insight: The export goods that experienced the largest declines in value between 2008 and 2010 during the financial crisis in Luxembourg were Machinery and mechanical appliances, which fell by 4.06 billion euros to 2.03 billion euros.
This represents a 66.7% decrease, the most significant drop among the listed products.
Iron and steel exports also declined notably, decreasing by 871.3 million euros to 1.80 billion euros, a 32.7% reduction.
Rubber and articles thereof, Vehicles and parts, and Articles of iron or steel also saw declines of 36.8%, 27.9%, and 29.0% respectively.
The data are in current euros and not adjusted for price changes, and 1.8% of the export values are confidential and shown separately.
